hello.text: Welcome to Wakewell, sleeper. You'll feel heavy for a day or two. It passes, like most things, though not as fast as the soup.

t0.text: An abbey for the waking. We don't worship the Sleepers. We just catch them as they come out, give them a bowl and a bed, and point them somewhere useful.

t1.text: Bryce has work for anyone with two arms. Maudie has work for anyone who'll listen. When you've done with them, come and see me, and I'll send you on.
